scenarios.mech: Final guidance retains the supplemental draft's compliance approach for registered food facilities, with explanatory clarifications.
Final guidance offers more flexible ways to satisfy existing intentional-adulteration requirements without changing the underlying regulation.

forecasts.notes: The supplemental draft signals developed guidance, but FDA guidance finalization commonly takes years and has uncertain timing. Ten months since publication permits near-term action without making it likely. Sparse substantive evidence limits content differentiation.
